2021_213_biographical_sketches.paragraph: Biographical sketches prepared for the Troy School District Board of Education meeting of September 21, 2021 profile newly hired certified staff, giving each person's FTE and assignment, degrees and granting institutions, teaching certificate, prior teaching or clinical experience, and community of residence. The hires cover elementary, middle and high school classroom positions plus counselors, social workers, a school psychologist, speech pathologists, special education teachers and Troy Preschool early childhood educators, staffing buildings including Athens High School, Troy High School, Boulan Park, Baker, Larson and Smith middle schools, and Barnard, Bemis, Costello, Hamilton, Hill, Leonard, Martell, Morse, Schroeder, Troy Union, Wass and Wattles elementary schools. Oakland University, Michigan State University, Wayne State University, Central Michigan University and the University of Michigan recur as degree sources, and several appointees are Troy residents.
2021_213_biographical_sketches.page:
**Purpose**
Personnel item for the Troy School District Board of Education meeting of September 21, 2021: biographical sketches of newly hired certified staff. Each entry follows a fixed format of Educational Background, Teaching Experience (or Teaching/Background Experience) and Resident Community.

**Secondary assignments**
Athens High School: Haley Beard (English), Padro Gould (Business-CTE), Jessica McHale (Math), David Said (Social Studies), Victoria Petrouneas-Mantzios (Resource Room), Seth Wyatt (Special Education Level IV Room), Fan Zhang (.4 Chinese), and Sathyaja Krishnan-Nair (Science, shared with Boulan Park Middle School). Troy High School: Andre Collaku and Joseph Verhelle (English), Joseph D'Orazio (Physical Education/Health), Justin Nelson (Social Studies), Karoline Newer (Resource Room), Wendy Stuart (Orchestra), Meghan Kosters (.6 Marketing/Finance-.4 Health), John Le and Taylor Young (Counselors). International Academy East: Nicholas Holevar (Social Studies), Amanda Peters (History), Shane Norris (Spanish). Troy College and Career High School: Derek Mohamedally (Counselor).

**Middle schools**
Boulan Park: Jordan Baines and Andrew Scovoronski (Math), Julia Barraco (Social Studies), Jordan Held and Megan Luther (English/Language Arts), Duran Franklin (Physical Education-Health), Lindsay Howard (Special Education ASD). Baker: Cindy Kaump and Megan Ross (ELA), Jeena Philip and Stephanie Smith (Science), Emily Stetson (ELA/Social Studies). Larson: Kyle Maxson (Science), Maria Mendola (ELA), Jennifer Said (ELD). Smith: Sara Hawks (.8 FTE ELD/.2 FTE ELA).

**Elementary and preschool**
Elementary classroom hires include Laura Beacom and Lindsey Huebner and Cody Jamieson (Leonard), Sara Davis and Nancy Kast and Bailey Tripp and Allie Zawada (Bemis), Benjamin Hill and Jacquelyn Tindall (Barnard), Alexis Chie and Jillian Pertler (Schroeder), Madison Edwards and Alana Esshaki (Troy Union), Meridith Jerome (Wattles), Sara Konja (Martell), Mary McClure (Costello), Vanessa Suarez-Manjarres (Morse). Troy Preschool early childhood educators: Julie Check, Lorraine D'Souza, Emma Kowal, Amanda Matousek, Tiffany Robinson, Elizabeth Waymaster, McKenzie Wezeman. Itinerant arts staff: Lisa Brown (Music, Hamilton/Bemis/Schroeder), Joanna Van Eizenga (Elementary Orchestra), Isaac Weiss (Elementary Strings), Emily Walker (Elementary Art).

**Special education and support services**
Special education: Chloe Church (Level IV, Troy Union), Abigayle Cohen (TSD Preschool), Hannah Dadles (ASD, Morse), Kaitlin Harrison (Level IV, Costello), Melissa Strauss (MICI Room), Michelle Waak (Costello Resource Room), Kristen Withers (Hill Resource Room). Social workers: Meridith Cervenak (Costello), Stephanie Indianer (Martell), Marina Karjo (Barnard), Bethany Welc (Special Education Social Worker). Psychologist: Drew Melesky (Martell/Morse/TCCHS). Speech pathologists: Trysta Lee (Wass/Smith), Courtney Motherwell (Troy Preschool), Theresa Saporito (Hamilton), Raquel Winn (Barnard).

**Credential patterns**
Most sketches list a Standard Teaching Certificate; several list a Professional Teaching Certificate (Jordan Baines May 2020, Sara Davis April 2021, Padro Gould May 2020, Sara Konja June 2021, Victoria Petrouneas-Mantzios June 2017, Jennifer Said April 2020, Emily Stetson May 2021, Wendy Stuart January 2019, Joanna Van Eizenga March 2017, Elizabeth Waymaster July 2020, Kristen Withers April 2021, Fan Zhang Chinese Mandarin April 2019). Non-standard credentials appear for Duran Franklin (Full Year Permit), Shane Norris (Interim Teaching Certificate, June 2021), Stephanie Smith (Temporary Teaching Certificate, April 2021), McKenzie Wezeman (Teacher Permit 2021-2022) and Stephanie Indianer (Social Worker Temporary Approval, August 2016). Shane Norris is the only entry whose teaching experience reads "None Listed." Several hires bring international or out-of-state service, including Sathyaja Krishnan-Nair (India), Lorraine D'Souza (University of Guelph, Ontario and Kerala Agricultural University, India), Karoline Newer (Spain and Thailand), Andrew Scovoronski (Utah), Emily Walker (Colorado) and Stephanie Smith (Illinois).

The single largest line is 18,150.00 posted 6/30/2021 to a sporting goods vendor category against budget unit 101904261870000, account 6410.
